chars.name: Yoimiya
chars.desc: Her Elemental Skill turns her Normal Attacks into Pyro arrows. She stays on the field and keeps firing while her team protects and buffs her.

teams.name: Vaporize Fireworks

members.name: Yoimiya
members.does: Fires Pyro arrows with her Normal Attacks while her Skill is active.

members.name: Xingqiu
members.does: His Rain Swords strike alongside her attacks with Hydro, so her Pyro hits can Vaporize.

members.name: Bennett
members.does: His Burst field heals and gives an ATK bonus to whoever stands in it.

members.name: Layla
members.does: Her shield keeps Yoimiya safe so she can keep attacking.

teams.note: Layla’s shield also fires Cryo Shooting Stars, which can Freeze or Melt with the team’s Hydro and Pyro instead of Vaporize. Many players still pick her for the comfort of a strong shield.
teams.lesson: Set up the supporters first, then let Yoimiya attack inside Bennett’s field while Xingqiu’s Rain Swords keep adding Hydro for Vaporize.

rotation.name: Nights of Formal Focus
rotation.what: Creates the Curtain of Slumber shield.
rotation.why: A shield keeps Yoimiya from being knocked around while she attacks.

rotation.name: Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen
rotation.what: Slashes the target with Hydro and gives Energy back to the team.
rotation.why: Puts Hydro on the target and helps charge his Burst.

rotation.name: Guhua Sword: Raincutter
rotation.what: Summons Rain Swords that follow the active character.
rotation.why: From now on, Rain Swords strike alongside Normal Attacks, adding Hydro even after he leaves the field.

rotation.name: Fantastic Voyage
rotation.what: Creates a field that heals and gives an ATK bonus.
rotation.why: Yoimiya gets the ATK bonus while she stands inside the field.

rotation.name: Niwabi Fire-Dance
rotation.what: Her Normal Attacks become Pyro Kindling Arrows for a short time.
rotation.why: Without it her arrows are Physical, so they can’t Vaporize.

rotation.name: Kindling Arrows
rotation.what: A string of Pyro arrows while Rain Swords add Hydro.
rotation.why: Pyro hitting a Hydro-soaked target triggers Vaporize, a big damage boost.

chars.name: Xiao
chars.desc: His Burst lets him leap high and crash down with Anemo plunges. His supporters set everything up first so his Burst window gets every buff.

teams.name: Wind Strike

members.name: Xiao
members.does: Repeated Anemo plunges during his Burst.

members.name: Faruzan
members.does: Her Burst lowers enemies’ Anemo RES and gives the team an Anemo DMG Bonus.

members.name: Sucrose
members.does: Her Skill makes Anemo Energy particles for Xiao and triggers Swirl.

members.name: Bennett
members.does: His Burst field heals and gives an ATK bonus.

teams.note: Xiao’s Burst slowly drains his HP, so Bennett’s healing helps him stay in the fight.
teams.lesson: Do all of the support setup first. Xiao’s Burst window is short, and every buff should already be active when he starts plunging.

rotation.name: The Wind’s Secret Ways
rotation.what: Lowers the target’s Anemo RES and gives the team an Anemo DMG Bonus.
rotation.why: Makes every Anemo plunge that follows hit harder.

rotation.name: Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308
rotation.what: A small Anemo blast that pulls enemies in.
rotation.why: Anemo Energy particles go a long way toward charging Xiao’s Burst.

rotation.name: Fantastic Voyage
rotation.what: Creates a field that heals and gives an ATK bonus; its hit puts Pyro on the target.
rotation.why: Xiao starts his Burst inside the field with the ATK bonus.

rotation.name: Bane of All Evil
rotation.what: His attacks become Anemo and he can leap much higher.
rotation.why: This is his damage window; everything before it was preparation.

rotation.name: Plunging Attack
rotation.what: Jumps high and crashes down with Anemo.
rotation.why: Repeated high plunges are where most of his damage comes from. Anemo hitting Pyro triggers Swirl.

rotation.name: Plunging Attack (again)
rotation.what: Keeps jumping and plunging until his Burst ends.
rotation.why: Staying in the rhythm of jump, plunge, jump keeps his damage steady.

chars.name: Eula
chars.desc: During her Burst, her hits charge the Lightfall Sword. When it ends, it crashes down with a big Physical hit. Superconduct makes that hit land harder.

teams.name: Superconduct Lightfall

members.name: Eula
members.does: Builds Lightfall Sword stacks during her Burst for one huge Physical hit.

members.name: Fischl
members.does: Oz applies Electro from off the field, so Cryo hits trigger Superconduct.

members.name: Diona
members.does: Her shield protects Eula and her Cryo particles charge Eula’s Burst.

members.name: Lisa
members.does: Her Burst applies Electro, and her passive lowers enemy DEF by 15%.

teams.note: Superconduct lowers the target’s Physical RES by 40% for 12 seconds. That’s why this team pairs Cryo with Electro for a Physical character.
teams.lesson: Shield and Electro first, then Eula’s Burst. Every hit during the Burst adds a Lightfall stack, so land as many hits as you can before the sword comes down.

rotation.name: Icy Paws
rotation.why: Protects Eula, and her Cryo particles help charge Eula’s Burst.

rotation.name: Nightrider
rotation.what: Summons Oz, who keeps striking with Electro.
rotation.why: Oz keeps putting Electro on the target after Fischl leaves the field.

rotation.name: Lightning Rose
rotation.what: A rose that zaps nearby enemies with Electro.
rotation.why: Her passive lowers enemy DEF by 15%, and the Electro sets up Superconduct.

rotation.name: Icetide Vortex
rotation.what: A quick Cryo slash that gives her a Grimheart stack.
rotation.why: Cryo on an Electro target triggers Superconduct: Physical RES down by 40%.

rotation.name: Glacial Illumination
rotation.what: Summons the Lightfall Sword above the target.
rotation.why: Starts the window where her hits charge the sword.

rotation.name: Favonius Bladework - Edel
rotation.what: A string of heavy claymore swings.
rotation.why: Each hit adds a stack to the Lightfall Sword, so more hits mean a bigger finish.

rotation.name: Burst detonation
rotation.what: The sword crashes down with every stack she built.
rotation.why: The big Physical hit lands while Superconduct is lowering Physical RES.
